answer: A meadow town keeps its register honest when standing comes from distinct apprenticeships in the guild vault. A newcomer completes one apprenticeship under a master who takes one apprentice and inspects the piece in person. The second identity needs two more masters, the fifth five more, so twenty fakes demand 210 apprenticeships, each with its own master and inspected piece. Bulk farming fails because masters cannot be cloned or bought in bulk, and one person cannot apprentice in twenty places at once, like a spiral staircase that admits one climber at a time.
